title: Ahab’s Family Killed

questions.question: How many sons of Ahab were in Samaria?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:1 (ESV): "Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria..."

questions.question: What did Jehu challenge the rulers of Samaria to do?
options: Select the best son of Ahab and fight for his father's house
questions.correctAnswer: Select the best son of Ahab and fight for his father's house
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:3 (ESV): "Select the best and fittest of your master's sons... and fight for your master's house."

questions.question: What did the men of Samaria do instead?
options: They said they were Jehu's servants and killed the seventy sons
questions.correctAnswer: They said they were Jehu's servants and killed the seventy sons
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:5-7 (ESV): "...We are your servants... And they took the king's sons and slaughtered them, seventy persons..."

questions.question: How did Jehu kill the worshipers of Baal?
options: He tricked them into a solemn assembly and had guards kill them
He burned the temple with them inside
questions.correctAnswer: He tricked them into a solemn assembly and had guards kill them
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:18-25 (ESV): "Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal... Jehu did it with cunning in order to destroy the worshipers of Baal... the guard and the officers struck them down with the sword."

questions.question: What promise did the Lord make to Jehu?
options: Your sons of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Your sons of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:30 (ESV): "...your sons of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel."

questions.question: What sin did Jehu NOT turn away from?
options: The golden calves in Bethel and Dan
questions.correctAnswer: The golden calves in Bethel and Dan
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:29 (ESV): "But Jehu did not turn aside from the sins of Jeroboam... that is, the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan."

questions.question: Who did Jehu meet and take into his chariot?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:15 (ESV): "...he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab... And he gave him his hand... and took him up with him into the chariot."

questions.question: What became of the house of Baal?
options: They demolished it and made it a latrine
It was left as a ruin
questions.correctAnswer: They demolished it and made it a latrine
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:27 (ESV): "...and demolished the house of Baal, and made it a latrine to this day."

questions.question: Who began to cut off parts of Israel in those days?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:32 (ESV): "In those days the LORD began to cut off parts of Israel. Hazael defeated them throughout the territory of Israel."

questions.question: What did Jehu tell the worshipers of Baal he would do?
options: Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much
questions.correctAnswer: Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:18 (ESV): "...Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much."

questions.question: Who did Jehu find at the shearing house of the shepherds?
options: The brothers (relatives) of Ahaziah king of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: The brothers (relatives) of Ahaziah king of Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:13 (ESV): "Jehu met the relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah..."

questions.question: How many relatives of Ahaziah were killed at the pit of the shearing house?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:14 (ESV): "...And they slaughtered them at the pit of the shearing house, forty-two persons..."

questions.question: How long did Jehu reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:36 (ESV): "The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-seven years." (Correction: The text says twenty-eight years in most translations/manuscripts, ESV says 28.) Double check: ESV 2 Kings 10:36 says "twenty-eight years".

questions.question: What was Jehu careful not to destroy?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:29 (ESV): "But Jehu did not turn aside from the sins of Jeroboam... that is, the golden calves..."

questions.question: What did Jehu say to verify Jehonadab's loyalty?
options: Is your heart true to my heart as mine is to yours?
questions.correctAnswer: Is your heart true to my heart as mine is to yours?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 10:15 (ESV): "...Is your heart true to my heart as mine is to yours?..."

key_verse_text: Thus Jehu wiped out Baal from Israel. (ESV)
